text: | sb_physical | manufacturing FG and consolidated gates | Reconcile full gross physical V independently of attributed A at each gate, including main blanks, usable remnants, offcuts, stocks, each waste outlet and real emissions. Close total mass and Pb plus each relevant trace element independently. Whole mixed outlets occur once; source partitions are disjoint and sum to the whole without being added again. Distinguish metal, actual oxide/carbonate phases, free water and other water states by independent measurement. One residual cannot solve two unknown species or water quantities. PM, COD and total-Pb indicators are not molecular mass. Any X correction removes only an exact duplicate OTHER term on the same side, never a stock or opposite-side leg. | `lsta-working-lead-2018`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |

| sb_packaging | each packaging component pool | For each steel can and each actual film/bag/lid/strap/pallet component separately: opening empty + attached WIP + attached FG + reusable stocks + purchases P + supplier-included ingress I + first nonpurchase external ingress N_ext + external returns received ER + F_in = corresponding closing stocks + packaging on gross physical shipments S + external returns sent EO + waste W + F_out. Classify each actual external receipt exactly once: ER requires a traceable actual prior outward movement of the same component from this pool; among other receipts P covers every purchased component, including one paid within a whole-lot purchase price without a separate invoice, I covers genuinely nonpurchased components accompanying a supplier delivery, and N_ext covers all remaining first nonpurchase receipts, including third-party empty cans first borrowed or leased. I and N_ext are mutually exclusive; third-party first borrowing/leasing is not supplier-included I. F_in/F_out are separately named and independently measured actual material/water/species or phase-transfer legs into/out of this same component pool after excluding quantities already in P/I/N_ext/ER or S/EO/W. Include measured retained contamination and moisture change where actually present; internal cross-ledger transfers must have a paired counterpart and cancel only at the combined gate. Whole contaminated waste W is measured once, with non-additive material/content partitions and one provider. These are physical transfers, not invented purchases, Q or burden factors. Deduplication X removes only an exact same-side OTHER duplicate and cannot erase a genuine new retained-material input. No wet operation, reaction yield or quantity is assumed. Internal reuse cancels and is neither a first external receipt nor another purchase nor Q nor automatic coproduct. S follows gross shipments regardless of return or allocation share. Physical receipt quantity is independent of procurement and burden attribution. Retain procurement mode, legal owner, custody, cohort, inherited per-exchange vectors and one documented upstream/burden/service owner per component receipt; do not invent a new manufacturing purchase, whole-load charge or credit for N_ext. ER retains original history with no fresh supply provider. Whole mixed disposal and disjoint source partitions do not create extra providers. | `lsta-working-lead-2018`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
